integrity: All sign patterns are covered by a rigorously free eightfold normalization and complete integer enumeration with independently organized polynomial-square and autocorrelation moments. Equality orbit split is checked explicitly. Bibliographic originality is limited to the optimizer-orbit geometry, not the pre-existing minimum.
scientific_limitations: Exact binary 4-by-4 aperiodic aperture classification only; scalar optimum 304 / merit factor 16/3 is known from Eggers as documented by Schmidt (arXiv:1105.5176). No phase-unrestricted, higher-size, or infinite-family claim; inaccessible older originals leave a possible prior optimizer-classification risk.
title: Complete binary optimizer orbits of the \(4\times4\) square Fourier aperture
